title: Oozy Garlicky French Ricotta Clafoutis
description: A romantic French dish featuring ricotta, mirepoix-base, and garlicky flavors, perfect for a spring evening. This vegetarian-friendly clafoutis is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the diced onion, carrots, and celery in a little bit of oil until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, ricotta cheese, grated cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked mirepoix mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a 9-inch round baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the clafoutis for 35-40 minutes, or until it is puffed and golden brown.
Remove the clafoutis from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the clafoutis rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the clafoutis warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
